_source: Read off the IFM admin dashboard (ifm-dashboard-iota.vercel.app/ifm-admin-portal, Batch-wise) on 13 Oct 2026. This is the authority for which audience a session belongs to; the session LABELS in the catalogue are not — several say 'teens' for young-adult batches and carry upload dates rather than class dates.
_timezone: Asia/Kolkata (+0530). iPhone capture times are recorded with this offset, so they compare directly.
_how_to_use: Each video master carries com.apple.quicktime.creationdate in its moov atom. Match that datetime to a window below to get the audience. Date alone is NOT enough — see _collisions.
_collisions: 18-22 May 2026: IYA B1 (16:00-18:00) and IFT Batch 1 (14:00-15:30) ran on the SAME DAYS. Time of day separates them cleanly; date alone would merge two audiences, one of which is minors.

27-30 Jul 2026: IYA B3 (14:30-16:30) and IFT Batch 4 (14:00-15:30) ran on the same days AND their times OVERLAP between 14:30 and 15:30. A clip captured in that hour cannot be assigned by timestamp alone and must be judged by eye or left unassigned. This is the one window the method cannot resolve.
_default_rule: Confirmed by Aditya 13 Oct 2026: 'these were the only non-mummies batches so far'. So the seven windows below are the COMPLETE set of non-mummies teaching, and anything shot outside them is Mummies. That makes the default safe rather than a guess — the risk of a wrong default is showing adult women's footage as adult women's footage.
_matching_rule: Match on DATE first, then use time ONLY to separate the two date ranges where both audiences ran.

Strict time windows do not work. The IYA B3 clips were captured 16:05-17:44 against a scheduled 14:30-16:30, so a strict window discarded 70 of 113 real clips as 'outside every class'. Sessions run over, and the dashboard times are nominal.
15-18 Jun is IYA only. 9-12 Jun and 22-25 Jun are IFT only. Date alone settles those three.
18-22 May ran IYA (16:00-18:00) and IFT (14:00-15:30). The gap between them is clean, so split at 15:45.

27-30 Jul ran IYA (14:30-16:30) and IFT (14:00-15:30) and these OVERLAP. Split at 15:45 as well, but anything captured between 14:30 and 15:45 on those dates is genuinely undecidable and must be left for a human. Measured: zero clips in the folder examined fall in that gap, so the overlap may never bite in practice.
